8 MR. BARTELS: Mr. Chief Justice, and may it
9 please the Court:

11 claims for relief from a criminal conviction are

13 appeal.
14 However, a claim that trial counsel was
ineffective must be presented first to a trial court in
16 what Arizona labels a postconviction relief proceeding.
17 Petitioner agrees entirely with Arizona's
18 requirement that ineffective assistance of trial counsel
19 claims go initially to a trial court, and he does not
object to the label "postconviction relief" as such.
21 The issue in the case has to do with
22 Arizona's insistence that Petitioner had no right to
23 counsel with respect to the postconviction first-tier
24 review, portion of first-tier review, even though he did
have a right to counsel in the appeal portion of direct
